questions.question: What is a Dataset Relationship in AI/BI Dashboards?
options: A declared semantic join between two dashboard datasets that enables cross-filtering between widgets
A foreign-key constraint enforced by the warehouse
A lineage view in Catalog Explorer
A scheduled pipeline linking two tables
questions.correctAnswer: A declared semantic join between two dashboard datasets that enables cross-filtering between widgets
questions.explanation: Dataset Relationships are dashboard-scoped joins declared at design time. They tell the canvas 'when the user clicks a bar in chart A, filter chart B to the same dimension value.' Without declared relationships, cross-filtering doesn't work.

questions.question: What does the Genie Panel widget do?
options: Embeds a Genie Space inside the dashboard for natural-language Q&A on the dashboard's datasets
Generates charts from a prompt
Replaces the dashboard canvas
Creates new datasets
questions.correctAnswer: Embeds a Genie Space inside the dashboard for natural-language Q&A on the dashboard's datasets
questions.explanation: The Genie Panel is a widget that hosts a configured Genie Space. Users get a chat box inside the dashboard where they can ask follow-up questions in natural language. The Genie Space must be configured separately (Trusted Assets, Instructions).

questions.question: How are AI Insights generated?
options: By sending the chart's data + context string to a Foundation Model endpoint, which returns a text summary
By running a built-in statistical analysis
By querying a pre-computed ML model
By reading documentation comments
questions.correctAnswer: By sending the chart's data + context string to a Foundation Model endpoint, which returns a text summary
questions.explanation: AI Insights call a Foundation Model endpoint (e.g., databricks-llama-3.1-8b-instruct on Free Edition) with the chart's data, schema, and a context string. The model returns a text summary that appears under the chart.

questions.question: [Recall: BI Dashboards] What's the difference between a Parameter and a Dataset Relationship?
options: A Parameter is user-controlled filtering on a single dataset; a Dataset Relationship is a declared join between datasets for cross-filtering
They are the same thing
Parameters are deprecated
Dataset Relationships are UI-only and don't affect queries
questions.correctAnswer: A Parameter is user-controlled filtering on a single dataset; a Dataset Relationship is a declared join between datasets for cross-filtering
questions.explanation: Parameters (date range, region) are explicit user-controlled filters. Dataset Relationships are declared joins that make cross-filtering automatic — click a value in one chart, related charts filter. They serve different purposes and complement each other.

questions.question: What happens if your Genie Space's Trusted Assets don't include a dataset the dashboard references?
options: The Genie Panel will refuse to answer questions about that dataset, but the dashboard widgets still work
The dashboard crashes
The Genie Panel silently answers wrong
All widgets in the dashboard break
questions.correctAnswer: The Genie Panel will refuse to answer questions about that dataset, but the dashboard widgets still work
questions.explanation: Trusted Assets is a per-Space whitelist. The Genie Panel will not query assets outside that list. The dashboard's own widgets use the dashboard's own datasets, not the Genie Space's Trusted Assets, so they continue to work independently.

learnings: Dataset Relationships enable cross-filtering across widgets
Genie Panel embeds a Genie Space inside the dashboard
AI Insights call a Foundation Model endpoint
Parameters (user filters) and Relationships (cross-filter) serve different purposes
Trusted Assets are per-Space; dashboard widgets are not affected
